title: Anchor
description: The address of an interpretation. Two levels: a mandatory edition-independent Canonical Reference, and an optional edition-bound character Span. See docs/01-anchoring.md.

cr.description: Canonical Reference. MANDATORY. An anchor without a CR is invalid, which is what guarantees no interpretation is ever orphaned.

cr_end.description: Inclusive end of a range. Must share the CR grammar of `cr`.

granularity.description: Declared intent. Informational: `unit` and above require no span; clause and below require one.

span.description: Character precision within ONE unit of ONE edition. Optional. Always degrades to `cr` if it cannot be resolved.

origin.description: Edition id the offsets are measured in.

start.description: Unicode CODEPOINT offset into the NFC-normalised stored text of this unit in `origin`. Not bytes, not UTF-16 units.

exact.description: The quoted text. Redundant with the offsets on purpose: if the edition is corrected and offsets shift, the span is re-found by quote match.

prefix.description: Up to 32 codepoints before `exact`, for disambiguation.

grapheme_aligned.description: Snap to extended grapheme cluster boundaries. Required true for letter-granularity spans in Hebrew, Arabic and Devanagari, so that a consonant is never split from its combining marks.

projections.description: CACHE ONLY, never authoritative. Recomputable; deleting this loses nothing. Keyed by target edition id.

confidence.description: Below the display threshold the span is NOT drawn; the annotation falls back to the whole unit. Silently drawing a low-confidence projection puts words in a commentator's mouth.

via.description: Pivot edition, when projecting translation-to-translation through the source language.
